sql.value: SELECT '1' AS GRUPO,ad.PIN AS IDENTIFICADOR, gc.IMEI,gc.IMEI2 AS IMEI2,ad.OWNER AS PROPIETARIO, s.MID,gc.TELEFONO1 AS TELEFONO,s.OSVERSION AS OSVERSIONSLAVE,gc.OSVERSION AS OSVERSIONDEVICE FROM adm_devices_application ada INNER JOIN adm_devices ad on ad.ID=ada.IDDEVICE INNER JOIN adm_devices_model adm on adm.ID=ad.IDMODEL INNER JOIN master_replica_slave s on  s.SERIAL=ada.LIC AND s.MID>0 AND adm.IDPLATAFORM<>3 AND s.PENDIENTE=0 LEFT OUTER JOIN gen_device gc ON s.MID=gc.MID WHERE ad.PIN<>gc.IMEI AND IF( instr( ifnull(s.OSVERSION,''),'.') = 0 ,CAST( ifnull(s.OSVERSION,0) AS SIGNED),CAST(substr(s.OSVERSION,0,LENGTH(s.OSVERSION)-instr(s.OSVERSION,'.')-2) AS SIGNED))>=12 ORDER BY gc.CODBRIGADA ASC, s.MID

sql.value: WITH  max_id_cte AS ( SELECT MAX(id) AS max_id FROM master_replica_queue    ),    sdata AS (        SELECT s.mid, s.lastcid        FROM master_replica_slave s        WHERE s.CONDITIONAL = 1 AND s.pendiente = 0 AND s.lastcid <> 500000000    ),    qcounts AS (        SELECT s.mid, s.lastcid, COUNT(*) AS cnt        FROM master_replica_queue q        JOIN master_replica_slave s ON q.id > s.lastcid AND q.mid = 0         WHERE s.CONDITIONAL = 1 AND s.pendiente = 0 AND s.lastcid <> 500000000 GROUP BY s.mid),oper_cte AS (SELECT SUM((m.max_id - s.lastcid - IFNULL(q.cnt, 0))) AS total_oper FROM sdata s JOIN max_id_cte m LEFT JOIN qcounts q ON s.mid = q.mid) SELECT FORMAT(total_oper, 0, 'locale') AS total_oper FROM oper_cte WHERE total_oper > 2000000

sql.value: select 1 AS ID,COUNT(O.ID) AS MAP_TOTAL from gen_ot_cabecera O INNER JOIN (select MAX(ID) AS ID,TASK_ID from gen_ot_estados  GROUP BY TASK_ID) E ON E.TASK_ID = O.TASK_ID  INNER JOIN gen_ot_estados ER ON ER.ID = E.ID left join monitor_ot_pdf_generate m on IFNULL(O.AREA_EMPRESA,'') like concat(m.AREA_EMPRESA,'%')  and ifnull(m.CLASE_ACTIVIDAD,O.CLASE_ACTIVIDAD) like concat('%',O.CLASE_ACTIVIDAD,'%') and ifnull(m.CLASE_ORDEN,O.CLASE_ORDEN) = O.CLASE_ORDEN  and ifnull(m.NO_CLASE_ACTIVIDAD,'')  not like concat('%',O.CLASE_ACTIVIDAD,'%')  and ifnull(m.NO_CLASE_ORDEN,'')  not like concat('%',O.CLASE_ORDEN,'%') WHERE ER.ESTADO IN (5)  and m.ID is not null  and m.PDF_PLANTILLA is not null and IFNULL(O.PDF_CREADO,0) = 0  and TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR,ER.FECHA,NOW()) >= 24 HAVING COUNT(O.ID) > 0
